allowed_categories.database_not_covered: the element is non-zero in the sample but the database has no ELEMENT entry for it
allowed_categories.measured_zero: the element was measured as exactly 0 wt.% and the database does not cover it
allowed_categories.input_unknown: the element is declared but has no measured value; it is never treated as zero

_template_note: Copy to a new versioned file, for example config/calphad_exclusion_policy_v1.1.json, and point the adapter at it. There is deliberately no wildcard or 'ignore any element' form: every exclusion is an enumerated (sample_id, element, category) triple with a reason. This committed template must not contain measured composition values.
